**How to declare.** Pass 1 starts only on a declared head: the label `review-ready` on the PR, and these lines in the PR body, each at the start of a line:

    Code-complete: <the full 40-character sha of the head>
    Tested: <the build and test commands that passed on that head>
    Cannot-split: <why the change cannot be split>   (only over the 1,000-line budget)

Then remove the label `review-ready` and add it again. A push changes the head, so declare the new one. Over the budget, split the change as the guidance above says, or declare Cannot-split.
